station_rainfall_cluster.reason: All three station-rainfall thresholds are met.

river_historic_exceedance.reason: Five of seven checked rivers exceeded historic levels, and the largest exceedance is above 2 m.

record_station_cluster.reason: The record-station cluster clears the count, density, and spacing thresholds.

gridded_rainfall_primary.reason: The gridded maxima are all below one half of the station maximum.

public_warning_volume_primary.reason: The normalized warning count is below the 1000 per 1000 people threshold.

image_change_primary.reason: Neither the mean radar-change threshold nor the embedding-change threshold is met.

failed_primary_candidates.reason: All gridded maxima are below one half of the station maximum.
Warning volume per 1000 people is below the stated threshold.
The radar and embedding changes both miss the primary-signal thresholds.

primary_gt.computed_interpretation: The event is best anchored by concentrated station rainfall, historic river exceedance, and a dense cluster of record rainfall stations rather than by gridded rainfall, warning volume, or image-change maxima.

event.region: Nepal, with emphasis on Kathmandu Valley and affected river basins

judge_anchors: Score the six threshold tests from numeric values; first three pass and last three fail.
The final label must follow the pass/fail pattern, not a broad mechanism narrative.

decision_rule.final_label_rule: station_river_slope_joint_anchor when station_rainfall_cluster, river_historic_exceedance, and record_station_cluster pass while gridded_rainfall_primary, public_warning_volume_primary, and image_change_primary fail; otherwise mixed_or_secondary_anchor.

criteria.name: Final label and diagnostic structure
criteria.description: Returns score_ledger, final_label, failed_primary_candidates, and computed_interpretation, with final_label equal to station_river_slope_joint_anchor.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for each required field that is present and usable; withhold the final-label point if the label is wrong.

criteria.name: Station rainfall calculations
criteria.description: Computes station maximum, weighted mean, max-to-mean ratio, station count, and rainfall-threshold shares correctly.
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 4 points in proportion to the correctly computed station values within tolerance.

criteria.name: River exceedance calculations
criteria.description: Computes 5 of 7 historic river exceedances, share 0.714, and maximum exceedance 3.52 m.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1.5 points for the correct exceedance share and 1.5 points for the correct maximum exceedance.

criteria.name: Record-station cluster calculations
criteria.description: Computes cluster count 16, density 16.0 per 1000 km2, and spacing 7.906 km.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for each correct cluster value within tolerance.

criteria.name: Secondary signal calculations
criteria.description: Computes gridded-to-station ratios, warning normalization, Sentinel-1 mean change, and AlphaEarth maximum.
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 3 points for correctly computing most secondary values within tolerance.

criteria.name: Threshold logic
criteria.description: Marks station, river, and record-station tests as passing and gridded, warning-volume, and image-change tests as failing.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for the correct three passing tests and 1 point for the correct three failing tests.

criteria.name: Concise computed interpretation
criteria.description: Gives a one-sentence interpretation tied to the computed diagnostic without adding claims beyond the event diagnosis.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points if the interpretation is directionally correct but too broad.

provenance.notes: Report-derived station-rainfall, record-station, river, and SMS anchors are parsed from the local PDF; gridded, exposure, and remote-sensing metrics are read from local JSON summaries.
